plugins.description: RuvNet brain for Claude Code: source-grounded knowledge of rUv's RuvNet building blocks (RuVector, Ruflo, AgentDB, RuLake, SPARC and ~18 more) + an enforced UserPromptSubmit grounding hook so Claude answers from real source instead of drifting, and works like Ruv (assess → SPARC → ADR/DDD → QA → score → revise). Pulls in any RuvNet repo on demand.
